headline: Ray Dalio Says All Creativity Is 'Trapped' In Your Subconscious— and the Practice He's Used Since 1968 Is the Key to Unlocking It
summary: Meditation, according to investor Ray Dalio, has unlocked his creativity and played a key role in his successful investment career.
